patch.value:
Implementation slice of the accepted backend-neutral direction tracked in [pm-cli #1399](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1399). Specific backend-interface designs below remain proposals pending the shared core contract; this is roadmap work, not a claim of a shipped defect.

**Goal / scope.** The web app should be an SDK consumer across native PM backends rather than require a filesystem-shaped compatibility tracker. Keep web account/access-control storage separate from PM item authority.

**Static evidence at 74ee868.** [Database schema](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/74ee868dda81afe3cf22a16a8ab8780342f7c9af/src/db.ts#L72-L139) uses PostgreSQL for users/projects/context/groups/shares, not an authoritative PM item store. [Client construction](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/74ee868dda81afe3cf22a16a8ab8780342f7c9af/src/services/pm-runner.ts#L746-L762) binds clients/cache to `pmRoot` and derives `cwd`; [complete reads](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/74ee868dda81afe3cf22a16a8ab8780342f7c9af/src/services/pm-runner.ts#L847-L853) derive `.agents/pm`. [Mutation watcher](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/74ee868dda81afe3cf22a16a8ab8780342f7c9af/src/services/mutation-event-watcher.ts#L137-L145) constructs a tracker path; [resume packets](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/74ee868dda81afe3cf22a16a8ab8780342f7c9af/src/services/resume-packets.ts#L38-L59) use SDK mutation events plus path-addressed history. Existing PostgreSQL deployment therefore does not establish native PM database support.

**Existing work / nonduplication.** Reuse [mutation subscription PR #60](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/pull/60), [capability explorer PR #247](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/pull/247), and existing no-git/plain-directory acceptance. No-git is not the same as no-filesystem; preserve those tests, do not replace them.

**Work and acceptance.**
- Map an already-authorized project to a backend-bound SDK handle with stable scope/identity; cache on that identity and authorization boundaries, not just a local root. Avoid leaking connection credentials or tenant identifiers in public responses.
- Route item operations, complete reads, settings, point-in-time/history, decisions, durable idempotency and resume/event cursors through upstream capabilities. Keep web account/share metadata in its current scope; do not declare it the item backend merely because both use PostgreSQL.
- Keep filesystem sweeps only within the filesystem adapter's change detection; database backends need durable scoped event/cursor semantics and explicit gap/resync receipts. Preserve missed-event recovery and revocation checks without claiming global cross-source snapshots.
- Conformance against filesystem and a native backend with no local tracker: CRUD/search/custom metadata, history/resume, concurrent edits, restart and cursor retention, idempotency, access revocation, tenant isolation and unsupported feature responses. Git-specific features should remain explicit optional capabilities.
- Keep graph projections observational and capability-aware. Reuse pm-graph's existing `ProjectionSource` database reader rather than introducing a second database graph store (already delivered in [pm-graph PR #159](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-graph/pull/159)). Do not silently substitute an incomplete mirror for authoritative item reads.

**Investigation limits:** exact source revisions cited above were inspected read-only on 2026-10-25. No runtime tests or provider operations were performed for this proposal. All-status GitHub issues/PRs and relevant canonical project records were checked for overlap.

**Coordinated upstream dependencies:** [ports and coupling inventory #1587](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1587), [backend conformance #1588](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1588), and [migration fidelity #1589](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1589). See the [coordinated roadmap](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1399#issuecomment-6400102270). Contribute this package's native-provider and consumer requirements to those contracts early; these are upstream implementation dependencies, not a reason to defer surfacing constraints until the interfaces are finished.
Backend roadmap: bind authorized projects and realtime/history reads to native SDK backends
